subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Which Skill Workshop lifecycle approval contract should land for this timeout cluster: bounded approval inside the Codex watchdog, a longer approval window with a matching tool watchdog, or another async/polling shape?
rationale: The remaining choice affects how long generated skill apply approvals stay actionable, how timeout is reported to agents, and whether the approval card describes exactly the content that can be applied.

options.title: Land PR 100498 After Security Fixes
options.body: Use the maintainer PR as the canonical path once its approval-revision binding and docs concerns are resolved, because it addresses the watchdog, popup context, and non-wedging timeout result together.

options.title: Prefer A Narrow Watchdog/TTL Fix
options.body: Land a smaller timeout-only PR if maintainers want to defer popup metadata and structured timeout semantics, accepting that related UX issues stay open.

options.title: Pause For Approval API Design
options.body: Hold all linked PRs until maintainers choose a durable async or configurable approval-window contract for Skill Workshop lifecycle actions.

recommendation.title: Land PR 100498 After Security Fixes
recommendation.body: Use the maintainer PR as the canonical path once its approval-revision binding and docs concerns are resolved, because it addresses the watchdog, popup context, and non-wedging timeout result together.
